paper_reference_name: FERERO: A Flexible Framework for Preference-Guided Multi-Objective Learning

upstream.license: No repository license found at pinned commit; source not vendored
deviations: Official simplex-dual PGD equality subproblem, generalized from two to five tasks with the same normalized inverse-preference loss ray. Zero residual fixes relative loss ratios; no task-performance threshold is introduced. The paper classifies homogeneous ray equalities under its absolute-preference formalism, not a cone-only relative order.
Spectral step cap min(0.1,0.9/L) for numerical stability; agrees with official toy solver when cap is inactive. No fallback to weighted sum.
Shared-backbone Gram (as EPO benchmark); coefficients backpropagate through all task heads. Frozen Adam replaces toy outer SGD.

validation_id_integrity.source: existing VALID inter, read-only in-memory extraction
